content.text: With 40 runs contributed by John Campbell and a top score of 75 from Brandon King, the West Indies brought themselves close to matching Australia's first innings total of 286, aided by a 51-run partnership formed by bowlers Alzarri Joseph and Shamar Joseph.

Although Australia claimed victory in the first Test by a margin of 159 runs, they faced challenges on day one, getting bowled out for just 180 runs and experiencing difficulties with their top order once more in the second innings. At one point, the team found themselves in trouble at 65-4, but Travis Head, Webster, and Carey came to the rescue.
